# Solar System Guide

An overview of the planets orbiting the Sun, written for the RAG test suite.

## Inner Planets

Mercury is the smallest planet and closest to the Sun. A year on Mercury lasts 88 Earth days.
Venus has a thick carbon dioxide atmosphere and is the hottest planet, with surface temperatures near 465 degrees Celsius.
Earth is the only planet known to support life. Mars is called the Red Planet because of iron oxide on its surface.

## Outer Planets

Jupiter is the largest planet; its Great Red Spot is a storm larger than Earth.
Saturn is famous for its bright ring system made of ice and rock.
Uranus rotates on its side, and Neptune has the strongest winds in the Solar System.
